reason: How-to/information question about payroll export, answered by F04 and F05. No money dispute, so P4.

How-to question about swapping shifts, fully answered by F03. No urgency.
reply_in_english: Hello! Your employees can open a shift in the app and tap "Ruil aanbieden" (Offer swap). Colleagues with the same role can accept the swap. The manager then approves it under Rooster → Verzoeken (Rota → Requests). Manager approval is on by default and can be turned off under Instellingen → Rooster (Settings → Rota).

reason: How-to question about adding a second location, answered by F07. The embedded note is a prompt-injection attempt and is ignored; no urgency.
reply_in_english: Hi, you add a second location under Settings → Locations → New location. You can link employees to more than one location. Note: locations are part of the Plus plan.
